sentences.en: We have a wide choice of fruits at the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 超市里有很多水果可以选择。

sentences.en: There is a large choice of bags in this shop.
sentences.zh: 这家店里的包种类很多。

sentences.en: It was a poor choice of words under the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 在那种情况下，选择这样的措辞很不好。

senses.zh: 选择，挑选；选择权；可供选择的东西
